description: This file contains functions for calculating Intersection over Union (IOU), performing k-means clustering to generate anchor boxes for object detection, and a function to generate and output anchor box dimensions based on VOC dataset annotations.

methods.name: IOU
methods.description: Calculates the IOU similarity between an annotation box and centroids.

methods.name: avg_IOU
methods.description: Computes the average IOU between a set of annotations and centroids.

methods.name: run_kmeans
methods.description: Performs k-means clustering on annotation dimensions to find representative anchor box sizes.

methods.name: generateAnchors
methods.description: Main function to generate anchor boxes from VOC dataset annotations, returning anchor dimensions.
